name: L'Homme Sous Le Chapeau
source:
"You" are this year's sacrificial "spouse". Sacrifice to the Lord of the land living on the outskirts of your village. No one knows what became of them once they stepped foot past his gates. Will you survive or die trying like the rest?

[From [url=https://piinkpuddiin.itch.io/lhomme-sous-le-chapeau]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“你”是今年祭祀的“配偶”。向住在你村庄郊区的土地之主献祭。没有人知道他们踏入他的大门后会发生什么。你会像其他人一样努力生存还是死去？

[来自[url=https://piinkpuddiin.itch.io/lhomme-sous-le-chapeau]itch.io[/url]]
